goal: A change cannot switch off the reliability checklist item that judges it. This was the follow-up R30 left for roadmap R29: the checklist file was read only from the working tree.
changed: checklist.py also reads .agents/checklist.json as the merge base has it. An item there that matches the diff still prints, with a note, when the diff removes it or edits it so that it no longer fires.
